newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portuguese skinhead jailed for racist killing.
newsitem.headline: Portuguese skinhead jailed for racist killing.

text.p: A court has sentenced a Portuguese skinhead to 18 years in jail for his involvement in the racist killing of a young Tunisian man in the French port of Le Havre, officials said on Saturday.

The court in the northern city of Braga sentenced Michael Joaquim Goncalves, 23, late on Friday and fined him 25 million escudos ($141,000) for his part in the death by drowning of 19-year-old Imad Bouhoud in April 1995.
"The accused acted of his own free will with the intention to kill Imad, just because he was of Arab origin," the court said in a statement.
Co-accused French skinhead David Beaune, 25, is in French custody awaiting trial.
The court heard the two skinheads attacked Imad, pushed him into the harbour at Le Havre and made no attempt to save him as he drowned.
Channel Three television showed Goncalves's violent reaction to the sentence as he broke a microphone and shouted "Heil Hitler" with a Nazi-style salute to the cameras.
Television showed pictures of him struggling with guards and media reports said he broke windows of the courthouse before a squad of nine guards pushed him into a police van.
